Class MzTabWriter

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.exporters.MzTabWriter
public final class MzTabWriter extends Object
mzTab exporter — v0.9+. Reverses MzTabReader: takes identifications + quantifications (plus optional Feature rows) and emits a mzTab file. Both proteomics 1.0 (PSH/PSM + PRH/PRT + PEH/PEP) and metabolomics 2.0.0-M (SMH/SML + SFH/SMF + SEH/SME) dialects are supported.

Cross-language equivalents:
Python: ttio.exporters.mztab · Objective-C: TTIOMzTabWriter

    • write

      public static MzTabWriter.WriteResult write(Path path, List<Identification> identifications, List<Quantification> quantifications, List<Feature> features, String version, String title, String description, ProgressSink progress)
      Stage D overload that fires progress.onProgress(rowsDone, totalRows) every PROGRESS_INTERVAL_ROWS data rows (PRT / PEP / PSM / SML / SMF / SME) emitted and a final fire once the file is flushed to disk. totalRows is reported as -1L mid-emit because the writer accumulates rows across multiple sections before knowing the final count, and the final fire stamps both done and total with the exact row count.
      Since:
